# al-Qāḍī ʿAbd al-Jabbār

*935 – 1025 · Persian · [Kalām](../movements/kalam.md)*

A great Muʿtazilite theologian, author of a summa on divine justice and human freedom, the high point of the rationalist theology of [kalām](../movements/kalam.md).
